description_en: Tests the network connectivity between an API Gateway instance and a port on an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) or Server Load Balance (SLB) instance in a virtual private cloud (VPC) access authorization
description_zh: 测试API网关到指定VPC授权中指定实例的指定端口的网络连通性
name: ValidateVpcConnectivity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC access authorization
parameters.name: vpc_access_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API Gateway instance
parameters.name: instance_id

Connected.description_en:
Indicates whether the API Gateway instance is connected to the port. Valid values:

true
false
Connected.description_zh:
API网关实例到指定VPC授权网络是否连通
true：网络连通
false：网络不连通

IpType.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance in the authorization is an ECS instance or an SLB instance when the instance ID in the authorization is an IP address. Valid values:

ECS
SLB
INVALID: The instance type corresponding to the IP address is invalid
IpType.description_zh:
当VPC授权中实例ID填写为IP时，表示IP的实例类型
ECS：IP对应的实例为ECS
SLB：IP对应的实例为ECS
INVALID：IP对应的实例类型非法
